notes.title: Demo Patch 2.1.: the last update before the full release
notes.notes:
Thank you for joining us on this journey. Today we’re releasing Demo 2.1, the last update before the full game launches. This version polishes the experience and sets the stage for what’s to come.



What’s new:

Stargazer battle overhaul: now more deeply connected to the cosmos. Expect a spectacle of stars, energy, and celestial wonder that will leave you in awe.

Character portraits added: it’s time to meet Henry, his chickens, and the mysterious (and not-so-mysterious) inhabitants and visitors of Arcton, now with their own faces, expressions, and secrets.

Visual improvements: the entire demo area has been polished with enhanced graphics and atmosphere.

New soundscapes: music volumes have been adjusted, new sound effects added, and—wait, was that an owl or just your imagination? The forest of Arcton sounds more alive than ever.

Coins...? A few have begun to appear… but who left them, and why, remains a mystery.

Thank you for playing, sharing, and being part of this world.
Next stop: the full release.



See you very soon.

Moss Tower Studio Team

notes.title: Demo 2.0 patch: new areas, improved mechanics and gameplay
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We’ve been hard at work refining the demo as we prepare for the upcoming acts of Cosmic Horror Tales. Patch 2.0 brings a range of improvements aimed at enhancing both gameplay and immersion. Here’s what’s new:

1. New Tutorial Area
Dive deeper into Henry’s life and uncover the reasons behind his current mission. The revamped tutorial offers a more narrative-driven introduction to the story.

2. Expanded Mechanics
Players can now run, jump across gaps, climb, and interact with objects more fluidly, allowing for richer and more dynamic exploration.

3. Redesigned Menu System
The new in-game menu offers improved organization for items, clues, characters, light sources, and character upgrades, helping players stay informed as the story unfolds.

4. Enhanced Atmosphere & Audio
We’ve added ambient and navigational sounds to the user interface, along with new audio cues to further immerse players in key story moments.

5. Stargazer Updates
Our mysterious Stargazer has received a minor visual refresh and some small gameplay tweaks.

6. Improved Navigation & Hidden Paths
We’ve added new hidden passages and made adjustments to level layout, making exploration more rewarding and the overall journey more intuitive.

7. Bug Fixes & Performance
Resolved several issues related to the pause menu and implemented performance optimizations to ensure a smoother experience.

Thanks for playing the demo and for all the feedback so far! Your support helps us shape the future of Cosmic Horror Tales.
